name: Freya
source:
Claude's partner. A young dragon that for some reason loses magic power even without fighting monsters, a thing that shouldn't happen. In Claude's village there's a lullaby that says dragons t like Freya should be linked as partners, but Claude ignores the Chief's warnings and becomes partner with Freya. Together they travel to find why Freya loses magic power and why the lullaby says they shouldn't bond.

She instantly gets fond of of people(except Willow) and loves cute things. She calls Claude "Onii-chan".

Later on the story, depending how you educate her, she can have 4 possible personalities: Warm and Snug Freya, Intellectual Freya, Ojou-sama Type Freya or she can continue to be the same Freya with the same personality and the same Young Dragon undeveloped body.
